nodes.summary: The product is a comprehensive HR technology platform that simplifies the management of human capital, payroll, talent acquisition, and talent management. It leverages AI and machine learning to provide a seamless employee experience, accurate payroll and workforce management, and intelligent recruitment. The platform is scalable and caters to businesses of all sizes, from fast-growing businesses to large enterprises.

nodes.name: Human Capital Management
nodes.description: Manages all aspects of an employee's lifecycle from recruitment to exit.

nodes.name: Payroll and Workforce Management
nodes.description: Provides accurate, secure, and transparent payroll and workforce management technology.

nodes.name: Talent Acquisition and Management
nodes.description: AI-powered platform for intelligent and scalable recruitment and talent management.

nodes.name: AI and Machine Learning Innovations
nodes.description: Leverages AI and machine learning to enhance HR processes and employee experience.

nodes.name: Scalable Architecture
nodes.description: The platform is scalable and can cater to businesses of all sizes.

nodes.name: Enterprise-grade Security
nodes.description: Ensures the security of all HR data and processes.
